spots.name: Haigs Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 97 m (318 ft).

spots.name: Cooks Mount

spots.name: White Point Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.

spots.name: Weston Lake Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing south. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
